# Encore Outpatient Services

> > Encore Outpatient Services provides specialized addiction treatment and mental health care for complex cases and co-occurring disorders in Arlington County, Virginia.

Encore Outpatient offers comprehensive outpatient addiction treatment programs focused on substance use disorders, mental health conditions, and dual diagnosis cases. The center serves the Arlington County community with evidence-based therapeutic approaches for individuals with complex treatment needs.
